paragraphs.text: Pangolin is a creature type for a species of mammal with large, hardened overlapping plate-like scales covering its skin.

Pangolins (also known as "scaly anteaters") are normally found in tropical regions. They have a small head with an elongated snout, a long sticky tongue for catching ants and termites, and a tapering tail. As a defense tactic, they can roll up into a ball. A pangolin's scales are resistant to all sorts of damage and weaponry.
Pangolins are primarily aligned with black , green , or red mana.
The creature type was introduced for Reckless Pangolin from Global Series: Jiang Yanggu & Mu Yanling . Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths introduced another in Gloom Pangolin .
Prowling Pangolin , Ridgescale Tusker , and Bumbling Pangolin were printed as Beasts . Prowling Pangolin temporarily became an anteater in the Grand Creature Type Update until Fate Reforged .

Both Rowling Pangolin and Bumbling Pangolin gained the pangolin creature type in the Core Set 2019 Oracle update. Ridgescale Tusker gained the type later in 2020 with the Oracle update preceding Theros Beyond Death .
Pangolin beasts inhabit the forests of Avishkar. They are large, scaled animals with two tusks.
Dominaria is home to black-scaled pangolins that can grow to be multiple times larger than a human .
Ikoria is home to gloom pangolins which are nightmares . Gannet , a skysail zoologist, stated that it survives on a purely bioluminescent diet and is only active during the darkest of Indatha nights.
Pangolins inhabit the forests of Shenmeng . They are able to curl up into a ball and roll around.
While living pangolins haven't been seen on The Edge, Oreplate Pangolin appears to be inspired by one.
